start: Fresh install, phone sign-in switch on, no data on the phone

user_sees: Title 'Get stronger every week'
Line 'Log every set at the gym. See what you lifted the previous time.'
Orange button 'Continue with your phone number'
Link 'Try another way'
must_not: Every other way in shown before 'Try another way' is tapped
A blank screen or an endless spinner

user_sees: 'Join my gym' and 'Bring workouts'
'Use without an account' and 'Load demo data instead'
'Continue with Google' only in a build that can sign in to Google
must_not: The phone number button gone
Two orange main buttons fighting for the same tap

user_sees: 'Step 1 of 3' over the title 'Welcome to MettleUp'
Box 'Your name'
must_not: Anything saved to the phone's database before 'Start training'
A sign-in asked for

start: A store build with the phone sign-in switch off

user_sees: Title 'Get stronger every week'
Line 'Log every set at the gym. See what you lifted the previous time.'
'Continue with Google' (or 'Use without an account' as the orange button in a build that cannot sign in)
'Join my gym', 'Bring workouts', 'Load demo data instead'
must_not: 'Continue with your phone number' shown while its switch is off
'Try another way' with nothing behind it

start: First screen, 'Try another way' opened

user_sees: Title 'Join your gym'
'Scan the poster at your gym' with 'It is on the wall near the front desk'
'or type the gym code' and a 'Gym code' box
must_not: The gym joined before the 3 setup questions are answered

user_sees: The first screen again
must_not: The app closing
The typed code lost without a word

start: First screen, 'Try another way' opened, an old Hevy user

'From Hevy', 'From Strong', 'A MettleUp backup' with their hints

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with your phone number', type 9 digits, tap 'Check with WhatsApp'

'We did not find your number at a gym on MettleUp'

start: First screen, 'Try another way' opened, then 'Join my gym' opened

steps.action: Press Android back on 'Join your gym'
user_sees: The first screen with every way in still open
must_not: The app closing

user_sees: Only 'Continue with your phone number' and 'Try another way'

user_sees: The app leaves as usual
must_not: Anything saved by the steps above

start: First screen, switch on

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with your phone number' and read the screen
user_sees: Intro 'If your gym uses MettleUp, it may already have your number. We use it to find your gym and link this app to it.'
'We only use your number to find your gym. Your number is checked once and is not kept for this.'
'You pay nothing, and we never message you.'
must_not: The number stored with the attempt in plain text
A marketing WhatsApp message sent afterwards

start: Fresh install, switch on, a member on his gym's list

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with your phone number', type the number and the first name, tap 'Check with WhatsApp'
user_sees: 'Send the message in WhatsApp'
WhatsApp opens with a message to MettleUp ready
must_not: The 18+ and terms box skipped
A message sent without the member pressing send

steps.action: Send the message, come back to the app
user_sees: 'Looking for your gym...'
A card 'Join <gym>' and 'Your plan runs until <date>.'
must_not: Another member's gym or plan shown
The card shown for a gym that does not have this number

user_sees: 'Opening <gym>…' and then the app in the gym (F-phone-1605)
must_not: The 3 questions asked again when the setup saved
Back leaving the app while the gym is being joined

'Checking your Google Drive for a backup…'
must_not: Google becoming the main orange button

user_sees: 'We found your backup from <date> with <n> workouts. Bring it back to this phone?'
